limitations: All 134 property types and all 247 catalog/full keys were individually exercised through native applicable getters. This does not prove every ability-specific, minion, tag-combination or conditional combat consumer.

The full real Echo combat/completion/return/chest loop used production player objects plus a clone-only command driver. All 26 non-command objects match the final shipping build byte-for-byte; the driver is absent from the installed player DLL.

Two UnityPlayer access violations occurred earlier in the audit, including one in an intermediate clean player build. Their crash dumps remain available; exact root causes are not established. The final build passed two cold starts, 80 timeline/difficulty selections, all stat checks and actual HTTP/browser checks without a repeated crash. This is not a zero-crash guarantee.

Density and category pickups were replayed through the real game using the guarded driver. Native pickup eligibility and vanilla close-range collection remain active; Bones were refused at distance 10 and collected at distance 5. Disabling a mod category does not disable vanilla pickup.
Natural x1 combat drops and actual x2 item hook invocations were recorded. A controlled exact x1/x2 random enemy-drop ratio was not established.

Campaign/reward, CoF and crafting proofs retained from October 8 cover their unchanged native implementations. Not every newly released game version, special craft or random combat scenario was tested.
Weaver and Merchant Guild management remain informational. Tests cover Last Epoch 1.5.2 offline on this PC; no online or other-version compatibility claim.
